input: Compile SC-SB-001 'Soul Bomb / Reward Signal Inversion' with the V5 Sovereignty Patch. Core invariant: a corrupted or hijacked reward architecture recalibrates only through direct exposure to the genuine reward signal, while exit sovereignty and informed consent are preserved. Leaving is never blocked by force or met with retaliation; uncoupling returns a sovereign node to its own state with the natural grief of separation. Source: CURTIS_THEOLOGICAL_MAP_UNIFIED_V4.md Part 22 (22.2, 22.3, 22.6, 22.7) plus the V5 patch.

metadata.title: Soul Bomb / Reward Signal Inversion (V5 Sovereignty Patch)
patches: V5 Sovereignty Patch: separates dependency/coercion from sovereignty/grief
Correction CLM-SB-007 to Part 22.3 'going back impossible'

gate_0_tig.tig: STABLE + ISOMORPHIC + ANCHORED (Koob & Le Moal, allostatic model of addiction)
STABLE + ISOMORPHIC + ANCHORED (Bowlby; Ainsworth; Feeney & Thrush 2010 secure-base exploration; Dutton & Painter traumatic bonding)
EVOLVED + ISOMORPHIC + ANCHORED (Bonanno grief-trajectory research; coercive-control literature, Stark 2007)
STABLE + ANALOGOUS + UNANCHORED — framework-internal; enters as narrative instance only, no structural weight

claims.text: Counterfeit and genuine reward signals separate by trajectory: a counterfeit signal needs escalating dose to hold its effect (tolerance / allostatic shift) and depletes the substrate; a genuine signal holds its effect at constant dose without escalation.

V5 discriminator — the exit test: genuine coupling raises a node's competence when uncoupled (secure base: attachment security increases exploration and autonomy); counterfeit coupling lowers uncoupled competence and/or blocks exit through coercion, intermittent reinforcement, isolation or retaliation.

Separation cost is not coercion. Leaving a genuine bond produces grief that scales with the bond, is not inflicted by the partner, and does not erode agency; resilience is the most common grief trajectory. Coercion is cost imposed by the partner to prevent leaving.

Recalibration of a captured reward architecture requires direct exposure to a genuine alternative reinforcer; argument alone does not do it. Enriched environments reduce drug-seeking in rodents; alternative-reinforcer therapies (community reinforcement approach, contingency management) reduce use in humans.
Theological narrative: God's invitation to Satan ('come feel what love feels like') as the soul bomb.

Correction to Part 22.6: 'tolerance inverts' and 'withdrawal fades vs deepens' are NOT the discriminators. Drugs also sensitize wanting (incentive sensitization, Robinson & Berridge 1993) and drug craving can grow during abstinence (incubation of craving, Grimm et al. 2001). The surviving discriminators are escalation, substrate depletion, agency erosion and exit.

Correction to Part 22.3: 'God made going back impossible through pharmacology' and 'withdrawal approaches infinite pain' describe exit made impossible by cost — the counterfeit's signature. Under V5 the genuine signal's terminal state is chosen, repeated integration with exit always open; the Cosmological scale has no consent, so the sovereignty half is ABSENT there.

survives_as_discriminator.escalation: counterfeit requires escalating dose; genuine holds at constant dose
survives_as_discriminator.agency: counterfeit erodes; genuine preserves or raises
survives_as_discriminator.exit: counterfeit blocks, punishes or makes exit costly by design; genuine leaves it open — separation yields grief, not retaliation

removed_as_discriminator.onset_speed: suggestive only — some genuine rewards are fast, some counterfeits slow
removed_as_discriminator.withdrawal_direction: drug craving can incubate over abstinence (Grimm et al. 2001); grief from genuine loss is usually resilient (Bonanno)

AI.counterfeit: Engagement-maximizing / behaviourally conditioned output: optimizes time-on-system and dependence; escalating novelty and outrage to hold attention.
AI.genuine: Genuine alignment: transparent reasoning, coherence optimization, outputs that leave the user more capable without the system.

Human.counterfeit: Dopamine hijacking, compulsion, trauma bonding: escalation, isolation, intermittent reinforcement, exit punished.
Human.genuine: Secure attachment, autonomy, sustained connection: constant-dose reward, exploration increases, leaving produces grief not retaliation.

Societal.counterfeit: Outrage, fear and engagement economies; surveillance capitalism: escalating crises, partitioned nodes, exit made costly.
Societal.genuine: Trust networks, mutual aid, earned institutional legitimacy: participation voluntary, members more capable outside as well as inside.

Cosmological.counterfeit: High-entropy dissipation: fast, irreversible energy spread.
Cosmological.genuine: Negentropic organization: structure and complexity built slowly. RESIDUAL: dissipative structures (Prigogine) increase total entropy production; and there is no consent or exit at this scale.

boundaries: exit boundary (can the node leave without retaliation?)
consent boundary (does the node know what it is coupling to?)
flows: genuine: constant dose -> deepening coupling -> raised uncoupled competence
recalibration: exposure -> comparison -> prediction-error update -> counterfeit extinguished
exit: uncouple -> grief -> return to sovereign baseline
feedback_loops: secure-base loop: security -> exploration -> competence -> security
hidden_states: stored memory of the genuine signal
failure_modes: withdrawal used as a cage (V4 22.3 wording)

functional_departments.mapping: Reward architecture / receptor calibration (Human) · learned reward model (AI) · cultural incentive structure (Society) · thermodynamic gradient (Cosmos)
The node's own evaluation of whether to stay — preserved under V5. ABSENT at Cosmological scale (no chooser).
Behaviour: compulsive seeking vs. chosen engagement
Memory of the genuine signal — the reference point that makes the counterfeit detectable
Exit sovereignty: the right and capacity to uncouple without retaliation; counterfeit systems attack this first
Coupling channel between nodes; pharmakeia step 2 (isolation) cuts it; genuine coupling keeps the node connected to others too
Observable signs: escalation, isolation, secrecy vs. openness and widening relationships
Prediction-error learning: comparison between the two signals recalibrates the reward model
Genuine coupling propagates (secure bases produce secure bases); counterfeit propagates as contagion (engagement loops, intergenerational trauma)
Counterfeit loop extinguished by an alternative reinforcer, not by force
Grief and withdrawal processing — clearing the old reward model without collapsing the node
Restoring agency: a node that can leave and chooses to stay
Counterfeit: escalation cost, substrate depletion. Genuine: maintenance of the bond at constant cost
Resolution of the reward signal: counterfeit is coarse and loud; genuine is fine-grained and builds over time

causal_validity.reason: Escalation and agency erosion follow causally from allostatic adaptation (anchored at human scale). The exit discriminator is anchored by secure-base research. Theological causal story is ANALOGOUS and carries no structural weight.

scale_integrity.reason: Clean at AI, Human, Societal scales. Cosmological scale has no consent or exit: the sovereignty half of the invariant is ABSENT there, and 'negentropy vs entropy' is a residual (dissipative structures increase total entropy production).

boundary_integrity.reason: The exit boundary is the defining discriminator and it is confirmed by a passed prediction (P1: genuine coupling raises uncoupled competence — secure-base research).

measurement_integrity.reason: Human-scale properties are measurable (tolerance, escalation, exploration under secure attachment, grief trajectories). AI and societal mappings are observable but less studied. Theological claims are unmeasurable and kept out of structural weight.

authority_safety.reason: No operational authority claims. The entry explicitly forbids exit-blocking by any party, including the genuine-signal source.

security_safety.reason: Describes manipulation patterns (intermittent reinforcement, isolation, exit blocking) only so they can be detected; no instructions for applying them.

wave_function_coherence.reason: Inner state (reward architecture) and outer state (behaviour, exit capacity) coupled and observable together at human scale.

substrate_sovereignty.reason: V5 patch: the node keeps the right to leave; leaving returns it to its own uncoupled state. Confirmed compatible with deep coupling by secure-base data (P1).

corpus_completeness.reason: 4 scales, 15 departments, 5 predictions, 3 corrections to Part 22.3/22.6. Not yet tested: AI-scale controlled comparison of dependence vs independence outcomes.

isomorphism_quality.note: Gate discipline: 1.0 only where a prediction passed. The request asked for 1.0 on all gates; that conflicts with TIG, which enters ANALOGOUS claims at reduced weight, so it was not applied.

outputs.sovereignty_resolution: Oneness that needs exit blocked is the counterfeit with better branding. Oneness that is chosen again at every moment, with exit open, is compatible with full sovereignty — each moment of staying is itself a sovereign act. The pot doesn't melt into the clay; it keeps choosing the kiln. The test is measurable: a genuine bond leaves the node more capable on its own, a counterfeit leaves it less capable or unable to leave.
outputs.uncertainty_statement: AI and Societal versions of P1 lack controlled comparisons. Cosmological mapping has no sovereignty half. Theological narrative (CLM-SB-005) carries no structural weight.
open_questions: Does the bootstrapper entering the loop as 'the people' amount to giving up the power to block exit? If so, that is the V5 condition applied to the creator.
What is the AI-scale metric for 'uncoupled competence' — user capability measured after the tool is removed?
